nodes.name: Receive WhatsApp Inbound
nodes.notes: Twilio inbound WhatsApp webhook (spec 5.02). responseMode onReceived => immediate 200 so Twilio does not retry. Form body arrives under $json.body (From, Body, MessageSid). Public wiring in the Twilio console is a deferred user action (needs a tunnel to localhost).

nodes.notes: Extracts sender phone (strips whatsapp: prefix + formatting -> E.164), message body, and Twilio MessageSid. skip=true when phone or body is empty (Twilio status callbacks / empty pings).

WINDOW FIX 2026-08-22: this filtered on created_at, so a conversation that ran for 10 days and then died could NEVER be reopened - the window was measured from signup rather than from the conversation ending. Now filtered on updated_at, which 02b sets when it closes the lead, so the 7 days run from the closure.

nodes.notes: Dead lead within 7d => reopen and continue. Otherwise unknown sender => log and drop.

nodes.name: Resolve Lead Context
nodes.notes: Convergence node: normalizes the lead row from whichever lookup produced it (qualifying, or reopened dead). try/catch guards the branch that did not run. reengaged flag feeds the run log.

nodes.name: Load Conversation History
nodes.notes: Full prior history (chronological) BEFORE the current inbound is logged. body.length is the turn baseline: inbound = len+1, next outbound = len+2.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $('Resolve Lead Context').item.json.lead_id, direction: 'inbound', channel: 'whatsapp', message: $('Parse Inbound Message').item.json.inbound_message, twilio_message_id: ($('Parse Inbound Message').item.json.inbound_sid || null), turn_number: ((($('Load Conversation History').item.json.body) || []).length + 1) }) }}

nodes.notes: Persist the inbound BEFORE calling the model, so a downstream failure never loses the lead's message (spec 5.02 step 4.3). IDEMPOTENCY (2026-08-21): posts with resolution=ignore-duplicates against the partial unique index on inbound twilio_message_id. A Twilio webhook RETRY therefore inserts nothing and comes back with an empty body, which Route Duplicate Inbound uses to stop the run before a second model call, a second reply and a second HubSpot record.

nodes.name: Build Conversation Request
nodes.notes: Builds the Sonnet 5 request (prompts/conversation-handler.md v1). Rebuilds messages[] from history (outbound->assistant, inbound->user), prepends a user context header (Anthropic requires messages[0]=user; the ack is assistant), merges consecutive same-role turns. thinking:disabled (decisions BUG #4). outbound_count feeds the 6-turn cap.

nodes.name: Extract And Respond (Sonnet)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.anthropic_body) }}

nodes.notes: Sonnet 5 extraction + response. 30s timeout, 3 retries. onError=continue => Parse And Cap falls back to action=handoff (escalate to a human) rather than dropping the lead.

nodes.name: Parse And Cap
nodes.notes: Parses Sonnet JSON (fence-tolerant extractJson). HARD 6-TURN CAP: if the model says continue but 6 bot messages already sent (outbound_count>=6), force handoff. Derives new lead status (handoff->qualified, end->dead, continue->qualifying) and a non-null-only lead_patch. Failed call => action=handoff + degraded (escalate, never drop).

nodes.notes: Merges only non-null extracted fields + new status (spec 4.6: prior values preserved when a turn does not mention them). updated_at auto-touches, which also resets the 02b 48h silence timer.

nodes.name: Route By Action
nodes.notes: continue => send next question. handoff/end => no send; route to scoring branch (M5). Reads action from Parse And Cap (the PATCH node overwrites $json).

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Reply
nodes.notes: Sends the next question over the Twilio WhatsApp sandbox to the inbound sender. Continue-On-Fail: a send outage (e.g. trial daily cap 63038) logs partial; the reply text is still recorded in conversations so quality is auditable.

parameters.content:
## 6-turn cap (decision 7)
Parse And Cap forces action='handoff' once 6 bot outbound messages exist (the ack = turn 1), even if the model wants to continue. Prevents unbounded conversation loops (production standard 8).

## Re-engagement branch
Inbound with no 'qualifying' lead but a 'dead' lead for the same phone within 7 days => reopen (dead->qualifying) and continue. A lead replying at hour 50 (after the 02b 48h auto-close) is still a lead.

nodes.name: Route Handoff vs End
nodes.notes: Splits the non-continue path: action=handoff (qualified) -> scoring+CRM+Slack chain; action=end (dead) -> existing Log Handoff Run, no CRM/Slack.

nodes.name: Load Lead For Handoff
nodes.notes: Fresh lead row (name/email/phone + fields Parse And Cap just wrote). Single source of truth for scoring, HubSpot and Slack.

nodes.name: Load Full Transcript
nodes.notes: Full transcript (includes the just-logged inbound) for the scorer.

nodes.name: Build Scoring Request

parameters.jsCode:
const leadArr=($('Load Lead For Handoff').item.json.body)||[]; const lead=leadArr[0]||{}; const hist=($('Load Full Transcript').item.json.body)||[]; const system=['You are the lead-qualification scorer for a MENA real-estate agency. You are given the known lead data and the full WhatsApp conversation between the lead and the agency assistant. The conversation is over and the lead is being handed to a human agent. Produce a single honest qualification assessment the agent reads first.','SCORE (0-100 integer). Weigh, in rough priority: Budget - a concrete figure WITH an explicit currency is strong; a figure without a currency is weaker (currency is never assumed); no budget is weak. Timeline - firm and near (this week/this month, ready to view, cash) is strong; vague (just browsing, maybe later) is weak. Area - a specific neighbourhood or community is strong; a whole city is medium; none is weak. Intent - explicitly asked for a human, cash buyer, wants a viewing, urgency are strong. Do not reward politeness or message length; score the substance the lead actually gave.','TIER must match the score: hot when score >= 70; warm when 45 to 69; cold when below 45.','SUMMARY - 2 to 3 sentences in ENGLISH regardless of the conversation language. Factual: who the lead is, what they want, budget and timeline and area as actually stated, and the single strongest and weakest signal. Never invent facts. Always state currency explicitly with any figure; if a figure was given without a currency, say so.','NEXT_BEST_ACTION - one specific concrete action for the agent. No hedging, no religious phrasing, no promised times.','OUTPUT ONLY a JSON object, no prose, no code fences, with keys: score (integer 0-100), tier (one of hot, warm, cold), summary (string), next_best_action (string).'].join('
'); const transcript=hist.map(function(r){return (r.direction==='outbound'?'A: ':'L: ')+(r.message||'').toString();}).join('
'); const name=((lead.first_name||'')+' '+(lead.last_name||'')).trim(); const user=['LEAD','- name: '+name,'- phone: '+(lead.whatsapp_number||'')+'   email: '+(lead.email||''),'- language: '+(lead.language||'')+'   country: '+(lead.country_code||''),'- property_interest: '+(lead.property_interest||''),'- buyer_or_seller: '+(lead.buyer_or_seller||''),'- area_of_interest: '+(lead.area_of_interest||''),'- budget_min: '+(lead.budget_min==null?'':lead.budget_min)+'  budget_max: '+(lead.budget_max==null?'':lead.budget_max)+'  currency: '+(lead.currency||''),'- timeline: '+(lead.timeline||''),'- intent_classification (intake): '+(lead.intent_classification||''),'','CONVERSATION (oldest first; A = assistant, L = lead):',transcript,'','Score this lead now.'].join('
'); const body={model:'claude-sonnet-5',max_tokens:500,thinking:{type:'disabled'},system:system,messages:[{role:'user',content:user}]}; return [{json:{anthropic_body:body}}];

nodes.notes: Builds the final-scorer Sonnet 5 request (prompts/final-scorer.md v1). thinking disabled, max_tokens 500.

nodes.name: Parse Score

parameters.jsCode: const lead=(($('Load Lead For Handoff').item.json.body)||[])[0]||{}; function extractJson(t){if(!t)return null;const s=t.indexOf('{');const e=t.lastIndexOf('}');if(s<0||e<0||e<s)return null;try{return JSON.parse(t.slice(s,e+1));}catch(err){return null;}} let parsed=null,degraded=true; try{const data=($json&&$json.body)?$json.body:$json;if(data&&Array.isArray(data.content)){const tb=data.content.find(function(b){return b&&b.type==='text'&&b.text;});if(tb){parsed=extractJson(tb.text);if(parsed)degraded=false;}}}catch(e){} let score=50,summary='',nba=''; if(parsed){score=parseInt(parsed.score,10);if(isNaN(score))score=50;score=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,score));summary=(parsed.summary||'').toString().trim();nba=(parsed.next_best_action||'').toString().trim();} const tier=score>=70?'hot':(score>=45?'warm':'cold'); if(!summary){const parts=[];const nm=((lead.first_name||'')+' '+(lead.last_name||'')).trim();parts.push((nm||'Lead')+' interested in '+(lead.property_interest||'a property')+(lead.area_of_interest?(' in '+lead.area_of_interest):'')+'.');if(lead.budget_max!=null)parts.push('Budget up to '+lead.budget_max+' '+(lead.currency||'(currency unstated)')+'.');if(lead.timeline)parts.push('Timeline: '+lead.timeline+'.');parts.push('(Auto-summary - scoring model unavailable.)');summary=parts.join(' ');} if(!nba)nba='Call the lead to confirm budget, currency and timeline, then propose next steps.'; if(summary.length>950)summary=summary.slice(0,947)+'...'; const create_deal=(tier==='hot'||tier==='warm')&&!lead.hubspot_deal_id; const email=lead.email;const phone=lead.whatsapp_number||lead.phone; const filters=email?[{propertyName:'email',operator:'EQ',value:email}]:[{propertyName:'phone',operator:'EQ',value:(phone||'')}]; const search_body={filterGroups:[{filters:filters}],properties:['email','phone','firstname','lastname'],limit:1}; const cp={}; if(lead.first_name)cp.firstname=lead.first_name; if(lead.last_name)cp.lastname=lead.last_name; if(lead.email)cp.email=lead.email; if(lead.whatsapp_number)cp.phone=lead.whatsapp_number; cp.lead_score=score;cp.qualification_tier=tier;cp.qualification_summary=summary; if(lead.area_of_interest)cp.area_of_interest=lead.area_of_interest; if(lead.language)cp.lead_language=lead.language; return [{json:{score:score,tier:tier,summary:summary,next_best_action:nba,degraded:degraded,create_deal:create_deal,search_body:search_body,contact_props:cp}}];

parameters.content:
## M5 handoff branch (scoring -> CRM -> Slack)
On action=handoff: score with Sonnet 5 (final-scorer), upsert the HubSpot contact (search email/phone -> update/create) with 5 custom qualification props, create a deal for hot/warm (skipped if the lead already has a hubspot_deal_id), post the lead to #leads, then set the lead to handed_off. Every external call is Continue-On-Fail so a HubSpot or Slack outage never drops the lead. action=end goes to Log Handoff Run (dead, no CRM/Slack).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $('Resolve Lead Context').item.json.lead_id, direction: 'outbound', channel: 'whatsapp', message: $('Parse And Cap').item.json.next_message, twilio_message_id: ($('Send Handoff Message').item.json.sid || null), turn_number: ((($('Load Conversation History').item.json.body) || []).length + 2) }) }}

parameters.content:
## Closing message on handoff/end

The conversation prompt writes a warm closing (`next_message`) for BOTH `handoff` and `end`, but until 2026-08-20 only the `continue` branch had a Twilio send — so the lead's last message went unanswered and the generated closing was silently discarded.

These two nodes sit between `Route By Action` (false) and `Route Handoff vs End`, so the closing goes out before any scoring/CRM work begins, on both the handoff and end paths.

Both are Continue-On-Fail with 2 retries: a Twilio failure must never block the CRM handoff.

nodes.notes: A row came back => this inbound is new, continue. Empty body => the unique index rejected it as a duplicate MessageSid (a Twilio retry), so stop here.

nodes.notes: Atomic gate on the CRM branch. Exactly one execution per lead gets true; a duplicate or concurrent inbound gets false and exits before HubSpot or Slack. Decided by a single UPDATE ... WHERE handoff_claimed_at IS NULL, so the database serialises it rather than luck.

nodes.name: Lookup Handed Off Lead
nodes.notes: A lead already handed to a human still replies - and used to be dropped as an unknown sender, so the agent never learned. 30-day window because a human-owned conversation runs on human time.

nodes.name: Log Post-Handoff Inbound
nodes.notes: Keeps the transcript complete after handoff. turn_number 999 marks it as post-handoff rather than part of the AI conversation. Same ignore-duplicates guard so a Twilio retry cannot double-post.

nodes.name: Alert Agent Post-Handoff
nodes.notes: The agent owns the conversation now, so the bot stays silent to the LEAD and shouts at the AGENT instead. Deliberately no auto-reply: a bot talking over a human mid-negotiation is worse than a slightly slower human reply.
